supersedes: repair_ablation_plan.json, following the user's 2026-10-21 scope correction
scope: Spacing-repair policy after common feasible initialization; forbidden-location filtering and feasibility-priority selection remain enabled in all modes. No NSGA-III research.
initialization: All six algorithm/mode cells use the same initial 100 random keys repaired by the frozen bounded-backtrack policy. Include these 100 evaluations in the budget. Treatment begins at request 101. Verify initial returned keys, selected layouts, objectives and CV across cells for each seed.

modes.none: Select N smallest clipped keys without spacing repair. Invalid layouts retain their measured constraint violation and cannot enter the feasible Pareto archive.
modes.greedy: Frozen key-order greedy fill, no removal/refill attempts. On failure, retain original N indices with their true constraint violation.
modes.bounded_backtrack: Frozen greedy fill and at most 20 one-removal refill attempts; heuristic, not exhaustive search.

primary_metric: HV of all visited feasible layouts after 10000 requests, including the common initialization; common per-case empirical bounds pooled over all 60 runs; reference [1.1,1.1,1.1]. Record zero-range dimensions explicitly.
statistics: Two-sided exact paired sign-flip tests of per-seed HV mean differences, Holm over the four declared contrasts; report all paired differences, effects, wins and ties. Assumes sign-exchangeability under the null.
secondary_metrics: post-initialization raw and repaired feasible rates
interpretation: The treatment measures the complete repair policy, including writeback and the existing velocity-reset response; do not claim a pure geometric-repair effect with all downstream search states fixed.
The LMOCSO condition uses the declared base adaptation; do not silently substitute the fill-population intervention or alter APD to obtain a preferred ranking.
The first feasible solution exists in every shared initialization, so first-feasibility time is uninformative.
Equal requests do not imply equal physical evaluations or equal wall time.
No observed backtracking or no HV advantage is a reportable negative finding, not a reason to choose a different instance after seeing results.
One case only supports a local mechanism conclusion.
preflight_gates: decoder equality with existing policies including ties and failures
feasibility preference in both algorithm paths
exact next-step checkpoint recovery for all six cells
finite outputs and exact request budgets
runtime: Background execution only, kernel-lock duplicate protection, full last.pkl checkpoints, append-only per-launch logs. Never fresh-restart an interrupted run with an existing checkpoint.
historical_results: No original V3/V4/V5 files are overwritten. The old NSGA3/DGEA preflight remains archived and does not alone satisfy this new protocol.
